desc: Built in 1955 and expanded with an addition in 1970, this Modern International-style building was designed by Ellerbe and Company for the Mayo Clinic to house various functions of the hospital, which had outgrown its pre-WWII facilities.  The building stands 20 stories and 295 feet (90 meters) tall,
